name: B-Right RealEstate Ltd.
summary: B-Right RealEstate Ltd. operates as a property developer and construction firm, primarily undertaking the creation of both residential and commercial properties. Its portfolio of successfully delivered projects features developments such as Shah Arcade I, Parth Business Plaza, Solitaire Homes I, Jaliyan Heights, Parth Residency, and Parth Vaibhav I. Co-founded by Abhijit Dutta and M. B. Udani on October 22, 2007, the company's head office is situated in Mumbai, India.
